points.description: States that the star (*) operator is the dereferencing (indirection) operator.
points.partial_credit: Award 0.75 if only implied, e.g. says it 'accesses what a pointer points to' without naming it as dereferencing.

points.description: States that it returns/yields the object (value/variable) that its operand points to, i.e. the thing stored at the memory location the pointer holds.
points.partial_credit: Award 1 if it says it gives the value at the address but not that the operand is a pointer/points to memory.

points.description: States that the result is an alias (synonym) for the name of that object, i.e. it refers to the pointed-to object itself (can be used to read or modify it), not a copy or the address.
points.partial_credit: Award 0.75 if it says it can be used to access/modify the pointed-to object but does not use alias/synonym idea.
